intent: H1 and filesystem-derived fallback titles feed one SkillRecord.title authority surface and share the explicit resource/semantic admission contract without broad-strip laundering of edge controls.

The applied owner parses each decoded raw Markdown line through admit_markdown_h1_title and sends folder fallback through admit_skill_title.
appliedChanges: replace broad stripped H1 parsing with raw decoded-line semantic admission
route both no-H1 folder fallback exits through admit_skill_title
isolate SkillFallbackTitleError as a bounded title-stage discovery error
